pitch_detail.notes: Shannon Ridge Trail to the glacier snout.
Ascend the west side of the glacier to ~7,600 ft.
Summit pyramid gullies to the top (or SE Ridge, 4th/low-5th, as an alternative finish).
Steep snow/alpine ice from ~6,500 ft to the bergschrund at ~7,800 ft, avoiding seracs and sloughs.
Bergschrund crux: rock (left), ice (middle), or mixed (right).
Continue to the base of the summit pyramid.
Summit pyramid gullies on the south side to the top.
From bivy, traverse the glacier toward the North Face base.
Climb the North Face proper, avoiding terrain below the Hanging Glacier.
Steepens near the shoulder between Crystal and Hanging Glaciers, topping out NE of the Summit Pyramid.
Fisher Chimneys approach, then descend ~1,000 ft down the White Salmon Glacier and cross the NW Rib route.
Glacier travel and ice climbing on the Hanging Glacier.
Rock finish on the east ridge of the Summit Pyramid to the top.
Glacier ascent around outcrops/crevasses to base of Winnie's Slide (6,800 ft).
Climb Winnie's Slide to reach the upper Curtis Glacier.
Cross Curtis Glacier (large crevasses) to Hell's Highway snow chute.
Hell's Highway onto Sulphide Glacier, then West Ridge or central gully to the summit.
2-3 hrs crossing the Coleman and Roosevelt Glaciers to gain the ridge at ~7,500 ft.
Bypass a pinnacle on the right.
Bypass towers and bergschrunds left/east on low-moderate ramps.
Pass on the left; late season may require dropping to the Park Glacier headwall (AI3).
Regains the ridge crest to the summit plateau.
~3.5 mi / 3,300 ft gain, non-technical.
Skirt the rock Prow to the west, continue north.
Traverse toward a horn between Sherman Peak and the Roman Wall.
Finishes on the same terrain as the Easton Glacier route.
